snapshot.text: Insurance-based system run through the Croatian Health Insurance Fund. The EU's country health profile names the organisation of care as Croatia's main health-system challenge; waiting lists for diagnostics are a political focus.

priorities.title: More funding for family doctors
priorities.text: The health ministry has announced more funding for general practitioners, as part of strengthening primary care.

priorities.title: Private providers into national e-health system
priorities.text: From 2026 private healthcare providers must connect to CEZIH, the national e-health information system.

priorities.title: Cutting diagnostic waiting lists
priorities.text: The minister reports a downward trend in waiting lists for diagnostic checks.
